headline: Tyler, The Creator just hopped on & song “girls” for a remix that currently only lives on
body: Tyler, The Creator just hopped on & song “girls” for a remix that currently only lives on his YouTube page. No promo, no heads up, just a live link! This reminded me of the 2010s when YouTube exclusive remixes were the norm and I think more people should do it. Tyler is in his bag lyrically here talking about his hopes for a family and I’m curious if these will be continued themes in his upcoming music! What’d you think of the song and remix? @feliciathegoat.
